fields.statement: QA at the branch head: built with go build -trimpath to a scratch path and ran it in a scratch repo with a worktree and a separate detached checkout, a hand-written session record with dir set to the checkout. rhiza session message --dry-run --json named <checkout>/.rhiza/local/messages/<session>/0001.md; two real sends wrote 0001.md and 0002.md there and nothing under the worktree or main checkout, the queued pointer named .rhiza/local/messages/<session>/0002.md and that relative path resolved from the checkout, which stayed git-clean. A record without dir still wrote under its worktree. Sending from a subdirectory and through rhiza api call session.message gave the same checkout path. Failures stayed clean: exited session exit 3, blank text exit 2, unknown session exit 4. Deliver path covered by go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestSessionMessage|TestDeliver|TestTypePointer' -count=1 (ok) and TestScripts/(session-message|describe-golden) (ok).
